sections.title: Batch 4 — logo v3, dark mode, design v3, 50+ features, admin tools, full review (11 Nov 2026)
points: The Batch 1 shield with a wrench and a check is back, refined (two-tone, one-colour, light/dark), with an animated version and a full icon set made by npm run icons (D-021).
A night-mode button on every page: Light, Dark or System; the sun turns into a moon; the new mode grows as a circle from the button; saved in the browser and on the account; no flash on load (D-022).
Text size A−, A, A+ in the account menu and the footer.

28 screens scored before the redesign (docs/design/07-critique-v2.md); in-house illustrations for every trade and 15 scenes; bento landing page, worker dashboard and admin overview; layered surfaces (D-023).

Profile strength with real next steps; "You may also do…" (same-trade skills, one tap, Undo); matched words marked inside the typed text; example sentences in the website language; CNIC, mobile and rupee masks; drafts kept until saved (never the CNIC); upload tip "Take a clear photo of your certificate", compression, crop and rotate, progress with Cancel; notifications bell; Available/Busy switch; copy ID; welcome tour; confetti for milestones.

Search, filters, sort and page in the address; results as you type with matched words marked; sort by experience or approved proof; saved workers; compare two or three workers; recently viewed; share and print a profile.

Overview with queues and waiting times, audit-chain status, charts from real counts, live activity; Users page with suspend / reactivate; reason templates in three languages; CSV exports (audited, no CNIC, formula-safe); keyboard shortcuts in the review panels; duplicate-photo compare slider (D-024, D-028). Guide: docs/ADMIN-GUIDE.md.

Command palette (Ctrl+K), keyboard shortcuts (?), offline banner with automatic retry, installable app with a static-only service worker (D-027), scroll to top, session-ending warning, What's new, Help centre.

sections.title: Batch 3 — browser tooling, Step 3 and voice fixes, three languages, design v2, profile view/edit (10 Nov 2026)
points: The dev container has a system Chromium (.devcontainer/Dockerfile, CHROMIUM_PATH); Playwright uses it and never downloads a browser. Used only for http://127.0.0.1 pages.
npm run e2e (20 tests) and npm run screenshots run on their own servers (5001/5174) and their own local database dlm_e2e; the preview and its data are untouched; Atlas is never used.

Step 3 "Your skills": Continue now uses the server's onboarding state (it bounced back before); without a skill it explains why and links to the skill search. Tests: unit + e2e in Urdu, Roman Urdu, English.

Voice typing: a specific message for each Web Speech API error (not-allowed, service-not-allowed, network, language-not-supported, no-speech, audio-capture, aborted; Stop is not an error); speech language from the switcher (Urdu ur-PK, English/Roman Urdu en-US); shown only where the browser supports it ("works best in Google Chrome"); Gboard / Win + H help always shown; M2-13 notice kept. Tests with a fake SpeechRecognition.

Found by the new tests: footer jump while a page loads (layout shift 0.16 → below 0.002); the hero typewriter reserves its tallest line; trade cards keep their visible text as link name (WCAG 2.5.3); a new worker's browser no longer requests a profile that does not exist (404 in the console; profileExists in the onboarding state); :lang(ur) also matched Roman Urdu and gave it the Urdu font; avatar initials skipped non-letters; create-admin printed error codes instead of English.

English, اردو (right to left, Noto Nastaliq Urdu loaded only for Urdu) and Roman Urdu; first-visit chooser; switcher in header, hero and footer; whole page switches without reload, form input stays; choice in localStorage and, for logged-in users, User.preferredLanguage.
Every visible text is in frontend/src/i18n/dictionaries/ (en, ur, ur-Latn: same keys, tested); trade and skill names in backend/config/skillTaxonomy.js; dates with Intl, Western digits everywhere.
All Urdu and Roman Urdu texts are drafts for a native reviewer: docs/i18n/REVIEW.md (890 texts).

sections.title: Batch 2 — Module 3 (Phase 5), integration tests (Phase 6), documentation (Phase 7) (9 Nov 2026)
points: Models Evidence (metadata) and EvidenceFile (processed WebP bytes); storage service with save/read/remove (Vercel Blob could replace it later).

Upload POST /api/evidence: login and role checked before the file is read; multer in memory, 4 MB (413); type from the bytes (JPEG/PNG/WebP; HEIC "Please upload a JPG or PNG photo."; PDF refused); sharp auto-rotate, fit 2000 px, WebP q80, no metadata (EXIF/GPS removed); SHA-256 of the processed file (same worker + skill → 409); dHash look-alikes and exact copies from other workers flagged for the admin; consent required; 5 per skill, 30 per worker, 30 uploads per 15 minutes per network.
Worker: GET /api/evidence/mine, GET /api/evidence/:id/file (owner or admin; others 404, customers 403), DELETE /api/evidence/:id (pending/rejected only).

Admin: GET /api/admin/evidence (queue + filters), GET /api/admin/evidence/:id (duplicate side by side, b/d/u/E as opinion), PATCH /api/admin/evidence/:id (approve, reject with code, suspected fake with reason, revoke with reason), atomic with 409, all audited; stats include evidence.
services/trust/skillConfidence.js (pure; W = 2, a = 0.5; provisional weights) and a per-skill evidenceSummary (status, approved, pending, strength word) recomputed after every change.
Public directory/profile show the chip, approved count and strength only; skills=verified filter.
A skill with reviewed proof cannot be removed (no hiding a suspected fake).
npm run confidence:sensitivity (formula outputs, with the two documented weak points).
